features.title: Classic workspace
features.scope: Stage, tools, timeline, library, Properties and Actions; Light/Dark themes, saved panel layout and detached Tools/Timeline/Actions. Actions now includes Sources editing, source import/removal, linkage fields and source-specific project-check feedback. MovieClip export identifiers use the existing source-panel undo and validation flow.
features.limitations: Native Sources editing/feedback/save/reopen acceptance is pending. Drag-to-dock, tabs/splits and named presets are missing; VoiceOver/IME and multiple monitors are not fully verified. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: Rectangle and oval
features.scope: Gesture-based rectangle and oval creation, solid fills and strokes, and geometry transforms.
features.limitations: Rounded corners and arbitrary shape parameters are outside this item.

features.title: Pen, pencil and curve points
features.scope: Open and closed paths; line, quadratic and cubic segments; moving anchors and control handles.
features.limitations: Point insertion/deletion, tangent constraints and merging operations are tracked under advanced tools.

features.title: Compound contours and holes
features.scope: Solid fills for compound paths using nonzero/evenodd rules; bounds and hit testing account for curves.
features.limitations: Gradients, bitmap fills and masks are tracked separately.

features.title: Multiple selection
features.scope: Shift-click, marquee, Select All and selection-wide operations across visible, unlocked layers.
features.limitations: This is a defined, testable set of operations; complete Flash workflow parity is not claimed.

features.title: Free Transform
features.scope: Move, scale and rotate individual objects; uniformly scale and rotate a group of selected objects.
features.limitations: Custom pivots, skew and nonuniform scaling of multiple objects are missing.

features.title: Object clipboard
features.scope: Copy/Cut/Paste and Paste in Place transfer objects, dependent symbols, timelines and scripts; linked symbols include their project-source snapshot and reject conflicting sources before mutation. Text editors retain ordinary text paste. Complete resource snapshots transfer with remapped identities, exact content reuse and atomic path-conflict rejection.
features.limitations: Native acceptance of the new linked-source/resource transfer remains pending. The 8 MiB clipboard cap rejects oversized snapshots explicitly. Frame clipboard and native image clipboard are separate work. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified.

features.title: Library and nested editing
features.scope: Convert to Symbol, place instances, open symbols and navigate nesting while preserving identity and scripts. Explicit runtime export identifiers and their dependent symbol closures are preserved with program clipboard snapshots; equivalent exported closures reuse library identity and conflicts fail atomically.
features.limitations: Linkage and document classes are outside this capability.

features.title: Authored text
features.scope: Editable authored TextBox with logical dimensions, multiline/wrapping, installed regular/bold/italic fonts, size/color/leading and left/center/right alignment. Old unboxed Text retains its appearance until explicit conversion. AS3 TextField/TextFormat and AS2 createTextField share Rust state and line layout, with separate current/insertion formats and bounded whole-field/string editing.
features.limitations: Mixed character runs, HTML/CSS, input/selection/IME, auto-size, advanced paragraphs and full shaping/Flash metrics remain pending. Host font measurements may produce different line breaks and pixels; portable fonts are separate work. Native headless layout/clipping/Undo and in-app-browser reflow/alignment, independent fields and Restart passed. Native interactive editing remains pending; VERIFICATION.md preserves the exact scope separately from earlier plain-text evidence. Independent fba17ae evidence (TEXT-LAYOUT-HTML5-20261027T0409Z) covers only the actual uniform layout/format/refusal/Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Native live editing, other fonts/engines, mixed runs and input/IME do not inherit the browser pass.

features.title: Advanced vector tools
features.scope: Pressure-sensitive brush, point insertion/deletion, splines, shape splitting/merging, snapping and groups.
features.limitations: These remain in the backlog; the Pen tool does not establish support for this set.

features.title: Gradients, masks and effects
features.scope: Gradient and bitmap fills, masks, filters and their authoring operations.
features.limitations: Solid fills and strokes exist, but these additional paint and effect types are not implemented.

features.title: Layer organization
features.scope: Create/delete layers and toggle visibility and locking.
features.limitations: Folders, guides/masks and complete layer reordering operations are still needed.

features.title: Keyframes, blank frames and holds
features.scope: F5/F6/F7 and moving/copying individual keyframes; insertion uses the visible interpolated pose.
features.limitations: Frame-range operations are tracked separately.

features.title: Independent nested timelines
features.scope: MovieClip instances have independent clocks; stopping a parent does not stop its live descendants.
features.limitations: This describes the current runtime contract; full Flash construction and reentrancy semantics are not independently established.

features.title: Graphic synchronization
features.scope: Graphic supports loop, play-once and single-frame modes relative to the authored timeline.
features.limitations: Exact compatibility with every mode in source Flash projects requires separate fixtures.

features.title: Pose interpolation
features.scope: Tweens match stable object identities and interpolate position, scale, rotation, alpha and supported geometry/color properties.
features.limitations: Independent property-level motion curves and complete Flash motion tween support are missing.

features.title: Easing and custom curves
features.scope: The model includes Linear, EaseIn/Out/InOut and cubic Bézier evaluation.
features.limitations: A complete visual curve editor, overshoot and individual property curves are still needed.

features.title: Onion skin and scrubbing
features.scope: Authored evaluation without script execution; onion skin with before/after range, anchoring, outlines and opacity.
features.limitations: Editing multiple frames is outside onion preview.

features.title: Shape morphing
features.scope: Paths interpolate when their command topology matches.
features.limitations: General shape tweening with different-contour matching, shape hints and topology changes is missing.

features.title: Frame-range operations
features.scope: Frame clipboard, span drag/copy/reverse, editing multiple frames and pasting while preserving layer structure.
features.limitations: Moving an individual keyframe does not provide range operations.

features.title: Complete Flash timeline lifecycle
features.scope: Removing and recreating an instance starts a new lifetime; stale dispatches are rejected and goto has protection against an unbounded queue. Same-path symbol replacement resets subtree overrides, custom fields and clocks, invalidates old proxies and preserves siblings; accepted in Chrome/in-app HTML5.
features.limitations: Construction/re-entry order, complex nested goto, scenes and complete Flash Player semantics still need conformance work.

features.title: Audio and video synchronization
features.scope: Timeline sound/video, synchronization modes, and coordinated playback stops and seeks.
features.limitations: Audio/video resources and their lifecycle are not implemented yet.

features.title: Self-contained HTML5 publishing
features.scope: Project export includes local JavaScript, a Canvas host and embedded WASM bytes, without Flash Player or a CDN.
features.limitations: This guarantee applies to the currently supported model; missing capabilities are listed separately.

features.title: Shared Rust/WASM core
features.scope: The browser uses the same timeline runtime; tests call the actual compiled WASM. Runtime-created object identity, hierarchy, solid drawing, transformed bounds/hits and captured lifecycle routes use the shared Rust/WASM scene while authored documents remain immutable. Explicit linked MovieClip namespaces reuse the shared timeline evaluator with independent frame scripts, nested clocks and ref-based semantic targets, including detached playback.
features.limitations: A shared implementation does not prove compatibility with Flash behavior. The combined dynamic-display browser workflow and Restart passed; authored/dynamic reordering and full Flash construction order remain bounded. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile.

features.title: JavaScript frame and object handlers
features.scope: Oxc parses synchronous frame/object function bodies, which the HTML5 host executes with the specified owner.
features.limitations: Project modules/imports and top-level await are outside this item. Code has the privileges of its containing browser page.

features.title: TypeScript frame and object handlers
features.scope: Oxc removes annotations and transforms supported runtime constructs in handlers.
features.limitations: TypeScript type checking is absent; imports/modules, JSX/TSX and external transform helpers are unsupported.

features.title: Authored events and interactivity
features.scope: Authored frame/Load/Click/EnterFrame handlers plus shared display/Stage EventDispatcher subscriptions, propagation/cancellation, bounded keyboard/pointer input and AS2 onEnterFrame/onPress callbacks. Captured AS2 Key/Mouse/Stage listener objects, keyboard state and hook-based cursor visibility share the same input hub and reset lifecycle. Publication-owned AS3 timers drive the same script/render lifecycle, with completion, elapsed-time queries and Restart cleanup; the geometry-timer example combines this with typed affine geometry and live text.
features.limitations: Full Flash construction/event order, remaining native callbacks, fullscreen/IME/touch and complete owner-specific API guards remain unfinished. Representative family behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; this is not full API or cross-engine acceptance. Independent frozen-01f1381 browser verification found trusted mouse click events with isPrimary=false dropped by the shared Stage guard; semantic Enter and keyboard paths passed. The corrected input route passed coordinate clicks and Restart in the original class/Stage examples; an unlocated aggregate observer exception remains open. The new AS2 combined scenario has executable host/WASM evidence; representative coordinate clicks, keyboard and Restart also passed in the in-app browser. The combined geometry/Timer browser workflow and Restart passed; historical Flash timing and cross-engine conformance remain unverified. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: Accessible Button/Image targets
features.scope: Authors set names, descriptions, roles and order; Tab and Enter/Space activate Buttons through the shared Click path.
features.limitations: This is a limited semantic overlay. VoiceOver, Safari and overall product accessibility remain unverified.

features.title: Preview zoom and navigation
features.scope: Fit, 100%, fixed zoom levels, scrolling and panning preserve authored geometry and access to transport controls.
features.limitations: Zoom is not responsive layout. Touch devices and Safari need additional checks.

features.title: DOM websites and apps
features.scope: Semantic DOM text, forms and inputs, web components, responsive layout and breakpoints.
features.limitations: Current publishing uses a fixed Canvas stage; the Button/Image overlay does not provide DOM authoring.

features.title: Project sources, modules and debugging
features.scope: Embedded AS2/AS3 source units use distinct bounded class profiles with exact imports, shared publication programs, authored symbol linkage and source-path diagnostics. AS2 root document linkage is a NeoFlash extension. Sources can be edited in Actions. AS3 projects can import bounded ByteArray/Endian buffers; unsupported native inheritance and constructor forms produce source diagnostics. Explicit exported MovieClip classes instantiate shared library timelines through AS3 construction or AS2 attachMovie, with independent namespace refs, nested clocks and script targets. Public AS3 get/set accessors and project interface contracts share the existing source compiler. Portable project resources feed the AS3 URLRequest/URLLoader/URLVariables and AS2 LoadVars families; requests share publication lifecycle and binary/event services.
features.limitations: JS/TS modules, SWC dependencies, complete type checking, completion, debugger/source maps and full class semantics remain pending. Representative linked-class behavior and Restart passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; native Sources acceptance remains pending. The AS2 combined export/WASM/input scenario passes; representative coordinate clicks, keyboard and Restart also passed in the in-app browser. Bounded binary-buffer workflow has independent browser evidence on 2b5deff; binary memory support does not imply loaders, external IO or resource-document support. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. Linked MovieClip and accessor/interface workflows passed the shared in-app-browser batch; native Export identifier editing remains pending. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified.

features.title: Portable fonts and text layout
features.scope: Font embedding/subsetting/outline export, font policies and predictable layout on a clean computer.
features.limitations: Export references fonts by name and emits a warning; fallback can change text appearance and wrapping. Shared Rust line calculation consumes each host font engine’s measurements, so it does not establish portable font metrics. Embedding/subsetting/outlines remain planned.

features.title: Image, audio and video assets
features.scope: Library imports and stores portable resource files, including image/audio/video bytes, with metadata editing, Undo and self-contained HTML5 packaging. The shared data service loads embedded text, bytes and form variables and supports bounded HTTP(S) requests. PNG/JPEG resources can be placed on Stage with transforms and smoothing. Shared Rust BitmapData buffers support bounded pixel edits, fill/copy/clone/scroll and disposal; AS3 Bitmap and AS2 attachBitmap use the same display graph and publication lifetime. AS3 Sound/SoundChannel/SoundTransform and AS2 Sound add complete-file MP3/WAV resource/HTTP loading, gesture-enabled playback, stop/repeats, volume/pan and completion callbacks.
features.limitations: General Loader/image formats, bitmap fills, filters/draw/encoding, streaming and timeline audio, video playback/synchronization and font embedding remain planned. Audio uses a bounded browser playback service; its own verification is recorded separately. Native resource/image panel acceptance and direct-file browser opening remain pending. The bitmap workflow passed combined export/WASM and in-app-browser observation of shared edits, independent source/clone, AS2 attachment and Restart. Full bitmap conformance is not established; exact evidence is in VERIFICATION.md. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified. Independent 1bd0e3c evidence (BITMAP-HTML5-20261027T0345Z) is restricted to the PNG/shared pixel, AS2 attachment, disposal and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. JPEG, rasterization options, alpha hits and native image authoring do not inherit that pass. The separate Sound delivery verifies ordinary AS2/AS3 MP3 loading, silent Play/Stop/Restart and actual browser MP3/offline PCM/native lifecycle; WAV native decoding, other engines and audible quality remain unverified.

features.title: Publish validation and script failures
features.scope: Invalid projects, compilation errors and missing runtime files block export; uncaught runtime failures are shown to the user.
features.limitations: Diagnostics for accepted ActionScript constructs do not establish semantic compatibility for every host interaction.

features.title: XFL and ZIP-FLA to project
features.scope: One scene, library, held keys, labels, nested instances, TRS/alpha, primitives, simple static text and a bounded subset of convex straight DOMShape geometry with solid fills and round strokes. Selected-profile InvisibleLayer policy and blank-gap placement IDs are preserved; ambiguous adjacent continuity and unsupported excluded-layer behavior produce diagnostics.
features.limitations: One unchanged real CS6 FLA has browser acceptance. General DOMShape, masks, media, rich text and skew are incomplete. Adjacent same-symbol continuity and excluded scripts/labels/extended duration are explicitly refused.

features.title: Imported source preservation
features.scope: Supported XFL preserves frame source and language, including text/CDATA fragments; nine original AS2 scripts from one CS6 FLA were checked against an exact 17-line HTML5 trace.
features.limitations: Document class/linkage and active external script configuration block import; retaining arbitrary source does not prove execution.

features.title: Container reading and limits
features.scope: Format detection, bounded ZIP/CFB readers, path/size/integrity checks and explicit refusal without overwriting the source.
features.limitations: Respecting container boundaries does not establish support for its contents.

features.title: Binary FLA structure
features.scope: CFB/MFC inventory, bounded Contents preservation, an identity graph and typed timeline records with exact unread boundaries.
features.limitations: Later Contents suffixes, many object classes, media and historical actions are not fully readable yet.

features.title: Binary FLA geometry
features.scope: Preserve bounded shape/style/edge records and original bytes; a strict adapter maps some Flash 3 solid contours to core Path.
features.limitations: Supported revisions, paints and topology are limited; successful contour conversion does not create an editable document.

features.title: Binary FLA to editable document
features.scope: Complete document conversion with layer order, placement identity, text, linkage, media, metadata and supported actions.
features.limitations: All binary documents in the current corpus remain can_import=false; structural reading does not count as document import.

features.title: SWF inspection
features.scope: Recognizes FWS/CWS/ZWS signatures and header/version fields.
features.limitations: Decompression, tag parsing, AVM1/AVM2 execution and source reconstruction are absent.

features.title: SWF playback and import
features.scope: A separate architecture for legacy playback and structured import; evaluation of Ruffle integration.
features.limitations: Ruffle is not integrated; SWF playback alone does not recover layers, source scripts or tween intent.

features.title: SWC and external AS libraries
features.scope: Dependency models, linkage, versions and the source/bytecode boundary for external libraries.
features.limitations: SWC import and a working linker are absent.

features.title: Compatibility corpus and fidelity
features.scope: Synthetic fixtures and the private corpus are supplemented by 15 unchanged, licensed FLA files: one exported to HTML5 with an exact reference trace and 14 explicit refusals; 21 input cases are checked reproducibly.
features.limitations: Complete per-file visual/behavioral comparison across Flash generations is missing. One real example does not establish general import support; private artwork is not published.

features.title: Independent project format
features.scope: Versioned JSON stores stable symbols/placements/frames/scripts; version 2 adds logical project source units and document/symbol linkage with path, size and reference validation. Existing version-1 projects remain supported. Version 3 adds portable resource bytes, normalized logical paths/types, strict base64/size validation and shared immutable storage across native snapshots; versions 1 and 2 remain readable. Authored Bitmap elements reference portable PNG/JPEG resource IDs with validated intrinsic dimensions; mutable runtime pixels stay outside the document. TextBox stores explicit layout dimensions and uniform formatting; legacy Text remains readable without conversion, and runtime insertion defaults stay outside authored state.
features.limitations: Additional media consumers, embedded font layout and broader asset dependency authoring remain separate work. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified. Independent 1bd0e3c evidence (BITMAP-HTML5-20261027T0345Z) is restricted to the PNG/shared pixel, AS2 attachment, disposal and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. JPEG, rasterization options, alpha hits and native image authoring do not inherit that pass.

features.title: Save and open projects
features.scope: The editor saves and opens .nflash through serialization and validation, without tying the document to absolute paths.
features.limitations: Autosave, recovery and multiple documents are tracked separately.

features.title: Undo/Redo for authoring operations
features.scope: Change history with one Undo for a completed gesture; a new edit invalidates the redo branch.
features.limitations: Resource-aware history for large projects remains to be implemented.

features.title: Work protection and recovery
features.scope: Unsaved projects offer Save/Discard/Cancel before New/Open/Import/Close.
features.limitations: Autosave/crash recovery, file-change detection and multiple documents are not implemented yet.

features.title: macOS integration
features.scope: Rust/egui application, core shortcuts, system fonts and a local .app for macOS 15+.
features.limitations: Native menus/document integration, IME, the accessibility tree and trackpad conventions need further work.

features.title: Automated checks
features.scope: Shared check.sh covers lint, Rust tests, actual WASM and representative script/family scenarios. The no-build batch tool exports selected projects independently and prepares one dashboard with separate export, observed runtime and manual behavior states.
features.limitations: Harness availability and export success do not establish browser behavior or Flash conformance. The current batch has shared automated evidence, eight successful exports and representative in-app-browser behavior; native Sources and other browser engines remain pending.

features.title: Scaling to large projects
features.scope: Validation/work budgets, expansion limits and cached browser path geometry exist.
features.limitations: Complete timeline virtualization, resource-aware undo and published performance budgets are missing.

features.title: Signed releases and platform matrix
features.scope: Local .app packaging with ad-hoc signing; Apple Silicon is documented as locally tested.
features.limitations: A notarized distribution release, verified Intel build, complete browser matrix and updater policy are absent.

features.title: Extensions and localization
features.scope: Public extension API, interface localization and stable product extension contracts.
features.limitations: The API and extension policy have not been defined yet.

features.title: Editor accessibility and overall verification
features.scope: Authored Button/Image metadata and individual browser keyboard/focus checks exist.
features.limitations: The native accessibility tree, VoiceOver and end-to-end accessibility verification for authors and visitors are still needed.
